name: macro-gap-finder
description: Finds the recurring manual answers in support replies you paste (CSV, JSON or plain text, 10 to 2,000 replies) and drafts a macro for each: the pattern, how many replies give that answer (counted in code by text similarity, not by the model) and a reusable macro text. Customer names, emails, phone numbers and long numbers are replaced by placeholders before any model sees a reply. A draft may only contain facts that at least two of its replies state; anything else is removed or the draft falls back to a real reply. Paste your existing macros too and it skips answers they already cover. Follow-ups: show the replies behind a pattern, a different minimum or top N, a shorter or friendlier draft. It creates no macro anywhere and does not answer customers or general questions.

skills.name: Find macro gaps
skills.description: Recurring answers in pasted agent replies, ranked by how often they occur, each with a draft macro grounded in those replies; customer data scrubbed first.
examples: Which of these replies should be macros? <paste the replies>
